{{Quote|They swarm over our vessel like '''barnacles!'''|Governor Quarg|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 13">[[Star Wars (1977) 13|''Star Wars'' (1977) 13]]</ref>}}
'''Barnacles''' were small crustaceans known for stubbornly clinging to surfaces such as the hulls of aquatic ships, starships, or the walls of buildings. A variety of [[Species/Legends|species]] could be found on many locations, including [[space barnacle]]s, [[Bilbringi VII]]'s [[crystal barnacle]]s and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[shadow barnacle]]s. More typical aquatic barnacles were those found on watery [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]] and the [[Alderaanian walking barnacle|walking barnacles]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
